verses.sanskrit: उत्तर उवाच । न मया निर्जिता गावो न मया निर्जिताः परे । कृतं तत् सकलं तेन देवपुत्रेण केनचित् ॥१॥
verses.english: Uttara said The kine have not been rescued by me nor have the enemy been defeated by me. All that has been done by the son of a celestials.

verses.sanskrit: स हि भीतं द्रवन्तं मां देवपुत्रो न्यवर्तयत् । स चातिष्ठद्रथोपस्थे वज्रसन्नहनो युवा ॥२॥
verses.english: Seeing me running away in fear, a youth of celestials birth, capable of wielding thunderbolt, stopped me, and got on my chariot.

verses.sanskrit: तेन ता निर्जिता गावः कुरवश्च पराजिताः । तस्य तत् कर्म वीरस्य न मया तात तत् कृतम् ॥३॥
verses.english: By him the kine have been rescued and the Kauravas defeated. This is the work of that hero and not mine.

verses.sanskrit: स हि शारद्वतं द्रोणं द्रोणपुत्रं च षड्रथान् । सूतपुत्रं च भीष्मं च चकार विमुखान् शरैः ॥४॥
verses.english: It was he who repulse with arrows the six warriors namely Kripa, Drona, Ashvathama, Karna, Bhishma and Vikarana.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनं विकर्णं च सनागमिव यूथपम् । प्रभग्नमब्रवीद्भीतं राजपुत्रं महाबलः ॥५॥
verses.english: That highly powerful one said to the prince, Duryodhana, terrified and broken like a leader of elephant-herds.

verses.sanskrit: न हास्तिनपुरे त्राणं तव पश्यामि किञ्चन । व्यायामेन परीप्सस्व जीवितं कौरवात्मज ॥६॥
verses.english: O Kuru prince, I do not see that by any means you are safe even at Hastinapur. Protect your life by displaying your energy.

verses.sanskrit: न मोक्ष्यसे पलायंस्त्वं राजन् युद्धे मनः कुरु । पृथिवीं भोक्ष्यसे जित्वा हतो वा स्वर्गमाप्स्यसि ॥७॥
verses.english: You will not be free by escaping. Therefore make up your mind, O king, for fight. By conquering you will enjoy the earth, and by being slain you will attain to heaven.
verses.bhavadeepa: व्यायामेन नित्यं देशान्तरसञ्चारेण एतेन स देवपुत्रस्तेषामग्रेऽपि नाशं करिष्यतीति सूचितम् ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: स निवृत्तो नरव्याघ्रो मुञ्चन् वज्रनिभान् शरान् । सचिवैः संवृतो राजा रथे नाग इव श्वसन् ॥८॥
verses.english: Thus addressed, the king Duryodhana, the foremost of men, sighing on his car like a snake, turned, surrounded by his ministers, and discharging thunder-like arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तं दृष्ट्वा रोमहर्षोऽभूदूरुकम्पश्च मारिष । स तत्र सिंहसङ्काशमनीकं व्यधमच्छरैः ॥९॥
verses.english: Beholding it, my hairs stood erect and the thighs to treinble. But he struck with his arrows that army of lions.

verses.sanskrit: तत् प्रणुद्य रथानीकं सिंहसंहननो युवा । कुरूस्तान् प्रहसन् राजन् संस्थितान् हृतवाससः ॥१०॥
verses.english: Having assailed those mighty car-warriors the Kurus. O king, the youth, powerful as a lion, laughed and stripped them off their robes.

verses.sanskrit: एकेन तेन वीरेण षड्रथाः परिनिर्जिताः । शार्दूलेनेव मत्तेन यथा वनचरा मृगाः ॥११॥
verses.english: Those six great Kuru car-warriors were defeated by that hero alone, as animals, ranging in the forest, are killed by a single angry tiger."

verses.sanskrit: विराट उवाच । क्क स वीरो महाबाहुर्देवपुत्रो महायशाः । यो मे धनमथाजैषीत् कुरुभिर्ग्रस्तमाहवे ॥१२॥
verses.english: Virata said-Dear son! Tell me where that illustrious and chivalrous angel who has won my cows once taken in possession by Kauravas in battle? I want to see and honour that angel for his valour who have defended you including all cows.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छामि तमहं द्रष्टुमर्चितुं च महाबलम् । येन मे त्वं च गावश्च रक्षिता देवसूनुना ॥१३॥
उत्तर उवाच । अन्तर्धानं गतस्तत्र देवपुत्रो महाबलः । स तु श्वो वा परश्वो वा मन्ये प्रादुर्भविष्यति ॥१४॥
verses.english: Uttara replied-"Dear father! That mighty angel had vanished there but I am sure enough that he will again appear here either tomorrow or the day after tomorrow.

verses.sanskrit: वैशम्पायन उवाच । एवमाख्यायमानं तु छन्नं सत्रेण पाण्डवम् । वसन्तं तत्र नाज्ञासीद्विराटो वाहिनीपतिः ॥१५॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana says-O Janamejaya! In spite of told impliedly, the king Virata could not recognise Arjuna, the son of Pandu living those hideously as an eunuch.

verses.sanskrit: ततः पार्थोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो विराटेन महात्मना । प्रददौ तानि वासांसि विराट‌दुहितुः स्वयम् ॥१६॥
verses.english: Arjuna, in disguise of Brihannala then gave all garments took-off from the bodies of great commanders (rathis) to Uttara, daughter of Virata in compliance with the king's order.

verses.sanskrit: उत्तरा तु महार्हाणि विविधानि नवानि च । प्रतिगृह्याभवत् प्रीता तानि वासांसि भामिनी ॥१७॥
verses.english: Uttara was exhilarated while receiving those various new and precious garments. O Janamejaya! Arjuna, the son of Kunti consulted the prince Uttara regarding revealing actual identity of Yudhishthira and decided duly all other affairs which were to be executed. O king! He then in a systematic manner, executed all affairs. Pandava, the greatest jewel to Bharata dynasty, exhilarated when all that arrangement was made in company of Uttara.

verses.sanskrit: मन्त्रयित्वा तु कौन्तेय उत्तरेण महात्मना । इतिकर्तव्यतां सर्वां राजन् पार्थे युधिष्ठिरे ॥१८॥
ततस्तथा तद्व्यदधाद्यथावत् पुरुषर्षभ । सह पुत्रेण मत्स्यस्य प्रहृष्टा भरतर्षभाः ॥१९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: मन्त्रयित्वेति । युधिष्ठिरे युधिष्ठिरविषये इतिकर्तव्यतामग्रे कर्तुमिष्टां भद्रासेन राज्ञ उपवेशनादिरूपां क्रियामुत्तरेण सह मन्त्रयित्वा तथा यथामन्त्रं तत् तां व्यदधादित्युभयोरन्वयः । हे राजन् जनमेजय ॥१८॥
